summary: Russian forces claim to be completing the liberation of Krasny Liman with organized Ukrainian defense broken and isolated pockets being destroyed. More than 42 ballistic missiles were launched at Kyiv and the region, a record according to monitoring. Russian drone and missile attacks also struck Odesa region ports and ships, causing one death and three wounded among foreign vessel crew.
key_points: Russian forces are completing the liberation of Krasny Liman as organized Ukrainian defense in the city is broken and isolated pockets are being destroyed, Gerasimov stated (Source: @tass_agency/385901).
More than 42 ballistic missiles were launched at Kyiv and the region, described as a record by the monitoring channel (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69204).
Four ballistic missiles were reported heading to Lukyanivka and two to Kyiv per separate monitoring posts (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69213).
Russia struck a locomotive and passenger cars of a train in Zaporizhzhia with a double hit; no casualties reported per Ukraine's infrastructure minister (Source: @UkraineNow/82744).
A Russian attack on a foreign vessel off Odesa under Antigua and Barbuda flag killed one and wounded three, with port infrastructure damaged (Source: @UkraineNow/82743).
Russian forces destroyed two dry cargo ships with military cargo at Odessa port and hit a ship at Yuzhny port per Russian MoD (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31734).
Ukrainian drones struck an oil depot in Moscow region, tankers and guard ship Svetlyak in Kerch per Ukrainian General Staff (Source: @UkraineNow/82745).
Russian Western group troops liberated Piskunovka and reached outskirts of Nikolaevka advancing toward Slavyansk and Kramatorsk (Source: @tass_agency/385878).

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces claim to be completing the liberation of Krasny Liman with organized Ukrainian defense broken and isolated pockets destroyed. More than 42 ballistic missiles were launched at Kyiv and region, a record per monitoring. Russian strikes hit Odesa ports and foreign ships killing one and wounding three, while Ukraine struck Russian oil depot and Kerch vessel.

points: Ukraine's General Staff reported a double Russian strike on a locomotive and passenger cars of a train in Zaporizhzhia; all passengers and staff were moved to safety with no casualties per the infrastructure minister (Source: @UkraineNow/82744).

A Russian attack on a trade vessel under Antigua and Barbuda flag off Odesa killed one person and wounded three, damaged port buildings, reservoirs and warehouses, and a repeated strike hit rescue equipment (Source: @UkraineNow/82743).

Ukrainian General Staff stated an oil depot in Moscow region was hit, tankers and guard ship Svetlyak in Kerch were struck, and a railway bridge over Belaya river near Sabivka in Luhansk region was hit (Source: @UkraineNow/82745).
President Zelensky said he spoke at length with Fedorov and Syrsky and that army decisions will be worked out; he thanked those who care for Ukraine (Source: @UkraineNow/82751).

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Botswana stated citizens are deceived with job offers abroad then forced to fight for Russia against Ukraine, with cases rapidly growing (Source: @UkraineNow/82753).

Police opened a criminal case after TCC servicemen in Lviv beat a 34-year-old man and forced him into a minibus; the man had minor injuries and a service check was ordered (Source: @UkraineNow/82746).

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces are pressing multi-axis advances in the east with claims of liberating Piskunovka, reaching Nikolaevka outskirts, and completing Krasny Liman clearance per Gerasimov (Source: @tass_agency/385878, @tass_agency/385901). Massive ballistic missile volleys exceeding 42 against Kyiv indicate intensified strategic strike campaigns (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69204). Southern ports remain under repeated drone and missile threat with foreign vessels hit, raising escalation risk to Black Sea shipping (Source: @UkraineNow/82743). Ukrainian deep strikes on Moscow oil depot and Kerch vessels show reciprocal expansion of target sets (Source: @UkraineNow/82745).
sections.regional_response: Botswana's Ministry of Foreign Affairs publicly warned citizens are fraudulently recruited and forced to fight for Russia against Ukraine, with cases rapidly increasing (Source: @UkraineNow/82753). Hungary's parliament adopted a constitutional amendment providing for President Sulyok's resignation per speaker Forsthoffer (Source: @tass_agency/385881). Russia and China are openly and timely discussing all aspects of Ukrainian settlement per Deputy Foreign Minister Rudenko (Source: @tass_agency/385911). No other regional actor responses to frontline events were explicitly stated in the messages.
